entities.name: ʿAbdallāh Ibn-Aḥmad Nasafī
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu al-Barakat al-Nasafi, was an eminent Hanafi scholar, Qur'an exegete (mufassir), and a Maturidi theologian. He is perhaps best known for his Tafsir Madarik al-Tanzil wa Haqa'iq al-Ta'wil.
